title: Fall schedule is locked in
body: Dates on the calendar are game days. Arrive the night before unless the event says you can drive in that morning. Cynthia is booking hotel blocks — links coming, same as summer.

title: Order the white pinstripes
body: Fall 2026 we added white pinstripe jerseys. If you don't have them yet, order them before the first tournament. GroupMe is still the team channel — this page is the written record so nobody has to scroll back for the call.
